abstract: Serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) was examined by radioimmunoassay in 125 Japanese with various gynecological malignancies. Elevated serum AFP levels were frequently noted in patients with yolk sac tumor and solid teratoma, while normal AFP levels (less than or equal to 20 ng/ml) were seen in those with vulvar carcinoma, cervical carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma or ovarian carcinoma. Serum AFP levels were also within normal range in patients with uterine choriocarcinoma or ovarian dysgerminoma. The present findings indicate that serum AFP is an effective marker substance for the diagnosis of both yolk sac tumor and solid teratoma.
abstract_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍125例（日本人）の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)を放射免疫測定法で検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍および充実性奇形腫の患者では血清AFPの上昇がしばしば認められた。一方、外陰癌、子宮頸癌、子宮内膜癌、卵巣癌の患者では血清AFPは正常範囲（20ng/ml以下）であった。子宮絨毛癌または卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の患者でも血清AFPは正常範囲内であった。本研究の結果は、血清AFPが卵黄嚢腫瘍と充実性奇形腫の両者の診断に有効な腫瘍マーカーであることを示している。
